% Derived from the TeX Live PGF decorations.pathreplacing manual wave examples.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usetikzlibrary{decorations.pathreplacing}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \draw[help lines] grid (4,3);
  \draw[blue,very thick,decorate,
    decoration={waves,segment length=8mm,radius=2.4mm,angle=40}]
    (0,2) -- (4,2);
  \draw[red,very thick,decorate,
    decoration={expanding waves,segment length=8mm,angle=12}]
    (0,0.4) -- (4,0.4);
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
